title: How the data center industry courts kids amid a backlash: 11+ firms and groups hosting field trips since 2025, flag kits and cards for first graders, and more (Caroline Haskins/Wired)
summary: Caroline Haskins / Wired: How the data center industry courts kids amid a backlash: 11+ firms and groups hosting field trips since 2025, flag kits and cards for first graders, and more — Amid a wave of backlash, some industry-friendly groups are employing creative and time-tested strategies to woo the youth.
